notes: Random mission states (network/split screen/local player, player count -1..4 with pause bytes, teams and score words, selected unit, hold flags, debug page 0..12, view mode, control delay, sub-step clock, end timer, saved-table flag) run for 1..9 frames. Every callee is a logging stub; the simulation-frame stub 0x1cde8 replays a per-frame table that changes the pause bytes, debug page, flags and the mission-done word. Value-returning callees return random sequences; 0x7489c returns null or one of four records with random landing flags; sprintf stores its value as the text and draw/width log the text.
